about: App Store screenshots (Tools/capture/screenshots.sh, then frames.py), listed per device below. Each is a still of a clip in clips.json, "at" seconds in (a clip's look, Tools/capture/footage.sh --look, shows where its moments fall), and a caption for frames.py. Captions follow the player-copy rules: simple and human, a hole is two greens, never A and B or pair.

devices.about: Each device's listing (screenshots.sh --device), in order: the shots above as its capture simulator shows them ("size"), or name@pose laid out in one of its poses instead (-canvas at that size, saved at "size"). App Store Connect takes up to 10 a device. Its iPhone Duo slot takes either screen in one set, so the Duo's leads with the inner screen, opened like a book (which a simulator can't do from the command line), then the outer one, closed, as the Duo's simulator boots.
